cards.title: Hands-On Dads and a More Peaceful World
cards.body: Pioneering scientist Sarah Blaffer Hrdy has rewritten the story of evolution by unpicking Darwinian sexism. Now she's turning her attention to how involved fatherhood could shape a better society.

cards.title: When Adult Children Move Back Home
cards.body: Many graduates are returning to the family nest due to economic pressures, forcing parents to readjust their parenting approach. Emma Beddington explores the challenges of having her son back home and navigating this new phase.

cards.title: Is Your Child Lying? It May Be Healthy Development
cards.body: While parents may be frustrated when their kids lie, experts explain that dishonesty is actually a normal part of child development. Understanding this can help parents respond more constructively to these moments.

cards.title: Should Parents Let Kids Play Grand Theft Auto?
cards.body: With Grand Theft Auto 6's release, parents are wondering what they should know about the game's impact on their children. Experts break down the considerations for this decision.

cards.title: Gene Editing and Parental Choice: An Emerging Dilemma
cards.body: As genetic enhancement technology advances, parents face new ethical questions about whether they should edit their children's genes. This article explores the implications of these choices.

cards.title: Messages That Linger: Asexuality and Motherhood Expectations
cards.body: Research reveals how asexual women are pressured with messages that they'll 'change their minds' about motherhood. These expectations shape identities, relationships, and personal life choices.
